batting.name: S Vidyut
batting.dismissal: c RR Raje b SM Pollock

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c YV Takawale b DJ Bravo

batting.name: CK Kapugedera
batting.dismissal: c YV Takawale b DS Kulkarni

batting.name: JA Morkel
batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b DS Kulkarni

balls.text: caught! Morkel tries to clear the long-off boudnary but doesn't get enough distance, the length is good outside off and he hits it straight to Uthappa who runs in to take a simple catch
a wide full toss outside off stump, Morkel throws his bat at it and gets a thick outside edge that flies to the third-man boundary
Dhoni tries to hit a full ball down the ground but gets an inside edge on the leg side
full and wide ball outside off stump, Dhoni waits on the back foot and slashes the ball hard behind point for four, he was deep in his crease and made use of the width
full toss outside off stump, Morkel reaches out for it and slices the ball through point for one
full ball closer to off stump, Morkel swings hard off the front foot but misses
another wide ball outside off, the pressure is telling on Kulkarni

another full and wide ball outside off stump, the wicketkeeper doesn't collect it cleanly and the batsmen sprint through for two wides, he's trying to bowl it full outside off to Morkel to try and prevent him hitting over deep midwicket but he isn't getting his line right
starts off with a wide ball outside off stump, six more to go

caught! Splendidly caught! Badrinath tries to pull a short ball over midwicket but gets a top edge that flies high in the air over the bowler's head, Bravo cuts short his follow through, turns around quickly and runs back, he covers good ground and then dives to take an athletic catch
Badrinath reaches his fifty in style, he waits on the back foot for a full toss and lofts the ball over long-on, the man on the boundary thinks he has a chance but the ball clears him
full and wide outside off stump, Dhoni reaches out for it and lashes the ball through point

Dhoni's hit Badrinath! Not like Harbhajan hit Sreesanth but this had to hurt more, the length was full and Dhoni drove the ball hard and straight at Badrinath who couldn't duck in time, the ball crashed into his shoulder, to his credit Badrinath was looking for the single off the rebound before he held his shoulder in pain
he's carved that over the extra cover boundary! Dhoni tried to hit that much straighter but the bat turned and he ended up slicing the ball high and far over extra cover, awesome power in the shot
Badrinath swivels ans tries to pull but mis-times it towards square leg
fuller length on middle stump, Badrinath moves across and swings the ball to the fielder at long leg, that's the most expensive over of the innings
that's streaky! Badrinath clears his front foot out of the way and tries to drive through the off side, he gets a thick outside edge that runs fine to the third man boundary
Badrinath hits the first six of the innings! Raje bowls the short ball, Badrinath gets into position on the front foot and pulls over deep square leg
Dhoni tries to loft the ball over midwicket but gets a top edge which falls short of the fielder at third man
a full toss swings into Badrinath who tries to drive on the leg side, he gets an inside edge towards fine leg, there was a little bit of reverse swing fro Raje
begins with a slower ball on a good length on middle stump, Dhoni moves back and drives the ball through cover
he does it again! Badrinath moves towards the off side, exposing all three stumps and chips the ball over the head of the fielder at short fine leg, excellent execution
Nehra pitches on a good length and skids the ball into Dhoni who swivels and tries to pull but gets hit on the thigh
Dhoni waits on the back foot and drives a short of a length ball powerfully towards cover
Nehra gives width to Dhoni outside off, Dhoni stays on the back foot and slashes the ball down to third man, Nehra can't afford to let Dhoni free his arms or he'll get hit more often than not
Badrinath walks a long way across his stumps and works the ball towards short fine leg
Dhoni tries to pull a short of a length ball but misses and gets hit high on the pad, the length wasn't short enough to pull and he may have got an inside edge on that

terrific! terrific placement! The length is a fraction short but there's width outside off stump, Badrinath moves extremely quickly on to the back foot and with a rapid slash of the bat, sends the ball racing past backward point, one again he's placed it square enough to beat third man
Dhoni moves back to a good length ball and drives towards point for  a single
Badrinath attempts to pull but the length isn't short enough and the ball reaches him much too quickly, he gets a top edge that falls well short of third man
Badrinath walks out of his crease and cuts Bravo hard towards deep cover to bring up the 50-run partnership
super improvisation, Badrinath walks across his stumps and lifts a short of a length ball that bounces a bit extra over short fine leg for four, predetermined but well executed
he pitches his first ball on a good length and skids it into Dhoni who tries to work the ball on the leg side but gets hit on the pad, he got a bit of bat on it
that's very wide outside off stump, it would have certainly been called but Badrinath reached out for it and edged the ball past the keeper to the third man boundary
too wide outside off once again, Badrinath cuts hard off the back foot but can't get it past the fielder at point
that's a bit too wide outside off stump, Badrinath lets it go and Kulkarni will have to re-bowl that one
Badrinath comes down the track and tries to drive but gets beaten once again
Badrinath backs away towards the leg side, gets down on one knee and tries to square drive through point, Kulkarni pitches just short of  a length and beats the bat with his bounce
Kulkarni bowls a full toss outside off stump, Dhoni leans forward and drives hard towards long off
good length delivery outside off stump, Dhoni drives hard off the back foot towards cover

Dhoni moves forward to drive through the off side and gets a thick outside edge to third man, Dhoni wasn't very comfortable with the ball swinging away from him and the keeper standing up to the stumps
full length outside off stump, Dhoni tries to drive straight and mis-times it towards the bowler
this time Dhoni leans forward and slashes hard at a full and wide ball, he gets enough elevation to clear the in-field and collect a boudnary through backward point

Dhoni's struggling with the swing away from him, he moves forward to a full ball that bends away from the right-hander and gets beaten on the front-foot drive, Takawale whips off the bails but Dhoni's back foot is grounded
once again the ball swings quite a bit away from Dhoni who tries to drive but gets a thick edge to the third-man boundary
Dhoni tries to drive through the off side on the front foot but gets beaten by the swing away from him
he starts off with a very wide ball outside off stump, the ball swung away from the right-hander
Badrinath moves across his stumps and tries to flick a good length ball that pitches outside leg towards the on side, he misses and gets hit high on the thigh
short and wide outside off stump once again, Dhoni moves back and hammers the ball through cover, this time he's hit it to the man on the sweeper boundary
short and wide, that's asking for punishment, Dhoni transfers his weight on to the back foot and cuts the ball with awesome power through covers, there's a fielder in the deep but he has no chance
short of a length delivery pitches outside leg stump, Badrinath moves across and tries to pull and gets a thick bottom edge towards fine leg
fuller ball pitches outside leg stump, Badrinath tries to play it on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pad
Badrinath backs away towards the leg side and tries to pull, Nehra bowls a short ball wider down the leg side
good length delivery to start with, defended on the front foot towards the off side
Dhoni moves back in his crease to a good length ball on off stump and drives firmly towards cover
Dhoni moves forward and flicks the ball off his pads towards square leg, he's extremely quick on the first run and comes back for two
that's just too full from Raje, Dhoni moves forward and drives the ball with immense power to the long-on boundary, he used his bottom hand to great effect
Badrinath drops the ball with soft hands towards point and calls for the single
a bit too short just outside off stump, the length allows Dhoni to move back and cut the ball hard through point, he's off the mark, finally
Badrinath leans forward and drives through covers for  a single

he can! What a spell! Pollock seams the final ball away from the right-hander from a good length, Dhoni fends off the back foot and gets beaten once again, Pollock's taken 1 for 9 off four overs, priceless spell

lovely! Pollock pitches the ball just short of a length and seams the ball away from the right-hander this time, Dhoni moves across and fends but gets beaten, loud appeal for caught behind but the umpire says not out
brilliant bowling, four dots in a row, Dhoni moves forward and across and tries to defend but gets hit on the pad outside off, he's getting the ball to cut into the right-hander
good length delivery outside off stump, Dhoni stands on the back foot and punches the ball towards cover
Dhoni once again moves forward and across and gets hit on the thigh by a shorter ball from Pollock that angles into the right-hander
Dhoni moves across his stumps and tries to work the ball through the leg side, he misses and gets hit on the pad outside the line of off stump

lovely timing and placement, Badrinath moves forward and makes use of the width outside off stump by cutting the ball behind point, he places the ball fine enough to beat backward point but square enough to beat Pollock at third man
Dhoni moves a long way across his stumps and tries to flick, he misses and gets hit on the pad, Raje appeals but the umpire says not out, that was close but Dhoni was a long way out of his crease
Dhoni charges down the track at Raje who drops the ball short and wide outside off, Dhoni lets it go, that may be the first wide of the innings
Badrinath plays the ball towards third man off the back foot for a single

shot! Badrinath moves on to the back foot and cuts the ball hard through point, Kulkarni fields on the boundary but gets into an awful tangle with his legs going all over the place and mis-fields, the ball goes over the boundary
defended back towards the bowler on the front foot
good length delivery to start with outside off, Badrinath tries to drive through cover but the ball seams away from th right-hander and beats the bat
another massive appeal for caught behind! Dhoni came out of his crease but wasn't in a good position to hit the ball because the length was a bit short outside off stump, he fends and gets beaten

he's gone this time! Kulkarni gets the ball to bounce a bit extra from just short of a length, Kapugedera gets on to the back foot and fends at it, he gets a thick edge through to Takawale, Chennai are reeling

Kapugedera could have easily been run out! He pushes the ball towards the off side and wants the single, Bandrinath sends him back after he comes a long way down, the throw comes in towards the wicketkeeper's end but the ball hits Kapugedera's bat as he was trying to make his ground

bowled him! Fleming strides forward to drive a good length ball that pitches outside off and angles into him through cover, he gets a thick inside edge and hangs his head in dismay after he hears the sound of ball hitting the stumps

this time he times it splendidly! The line is wide outside off stump and Fleming moves forward and hits the ball in the air over cover with a full swing of the bat, the ball pitches once before going over the boundary
Flmeing strides on to the front foot and tries to drive a good length ball through cover, he mis-times the ball back to the bowler
Bravo hits back with a good length delivery that nips into the left-hander and hits Fleming on the pad, Bravo appeals but the impact was high on the pad
Fleming gets under a short and wide ball and cuts it in the air towards the third man boundary, loose ball and Fleming took advantage
Fleming waits on the back foot and cuts a good length ball from outside off stump towards point
good length delivery outside off stump, cut off the back foot towards point
Badrinath moves forward and defends towards the off side, he wants the single but Fleming doesn't
Badrinath tries to cut Bravo but the ball pitches on a good length, bounces and seams away from the right-hander and beats the bat

that's just a fraction short and Fleming moves on to the back foot after initially coming forward, he pulls the ball over square leg and although he's not timed it fluently, he's placed the ball in the gap and will get four
tight line and length angling into off stump, Badrinath opens the face and steers the ball to third man
short and wide outside off stump, Fleming sits on the back foot and slashes the ball over point, there's a fielder on the deep point boundary now
excellent ball, Kulkarni pitches the ball on a good length just outside off stump, Fleming leans forward to drive but the ball seams into the left-hander and goes between bat and body
Fleming moves on to the front foot and drives the ball towards wide mid-on for two more
good length delivery on off stump, defended on the front foot back to the bowler
good length on off stump, defended off the front foot towards the bowler

caught! Bravo pitches just short of a length and gets the ball to bounce sharply on Raina, there is no room to cut and Raina jumps on to the back foot and tries to steer the ball to third man by opening the face of the bat, he only manages an edge through to Takawale
the short ball gets big on Fleming from just short of a good length, Fleming stands tall on the back foot, rides the bounce and steers the ball towards third man
better line and length on off stump, Fleming moves back and steers the ball to point
Bravo's lucky to get away with that, the ball is full outside off, Fleming leans into the front foot cover drive and times it well, he can't beat Uthappa at cover
smashed! That's a loosener from Bravo, short and wide outside off stump, Fleming leans forward and hits the ball hard through cover, that was hit in the air but also in the gap
outstanding ball, Pollock pitches on a good length around middle and off and seams the ball across the left-hander, Raina begins to push at it and gets beaten, only three off this over
shorter ball outside off from Pollock, Fleming stays on the back foot and opens the face to run the ball to third man
Pollock pitches the ball outside off and slants the ball across Fleming, the room is there for the drive but Fleming gets beaten as he comes on the front foot and throws his bat at the ball
this time the line is a bit too straight from Pollock which allows Fleming to move across and flick the ball off his pads towards long leg
Fleming tries to work the ball on the leg side but Pollock pitches on a good length and seams the ball into the left-hander,  he hits Fleming on the thigh
well well well, Fleming tries to hoick Pollock over the leg side once again, the length isn't full enough for the shot and he gets completely beaten and is nearly bowled
excellent comeback from Nehra, only two off this over, Raina moves back once again and pushes the ball towards point, Nehra didn't give the batsman any room to work with
Raina goes on the back foot to a good length delivery that angles into off stump and plays the ball towards point
Fleming strides forward to a full ball on off stump and plays the square drive behind point towards third man
Fleming leans forward to a delivery that angles into him and closes the face to play the ball towards square leg
good length from Nehra on off stump, Raina gets behind the line on the back foot and blocks, they scamper a single
good length ball outside off stump, Raina pokes at it off the front foot and gets beaten
defended on the front foot towards the bowler

caught! Vidyut tries to hammer Pollock over the straight boundary but mis-hits the ball high in the air towards mid-off, Rohan Raje positions himself under the catch and takes it comfortably with his palms facing upwards, Aussie style
driven elegantly through covers for two, nice timing

dropped!, Fleming tries to swing a good length ball over square leg but the top edge flies high in the air behind square on the off side, Jayasuriya calls for the catch and runs towards the ball, he doesn't get into a good position and dives to reach the ball somewhere in the region of backward point, he gets a hand to it but floors it
pushed off the hips towards square leg for a single
Fleming moves forward and tries to drive a good length ball that seams away from him, he gets an outside edge but it falls short of Tendulkar at first slip, he is standing very deep at first slip
short and a bit of width outside off stump, Vidyut dispatches the ball to the sweeper boundary with a hard square cut, expensive start from Nehra
better line and length, on middle stump, Vidyut moves back and pushes the ball towards the leg side
Vidyut backs away to make a bit of room and slashes hard at a full ball, he is looking to hit over cover but the top edge flies down to the third man boundary
fuller ball and there's a delayed shout from Nehra for lbw, the length was full on leg stump and Vidyut was struck on the pad after he missed the flick, the ball would have missed leg stump
better line, angling into off and middle stump from over the wicket, Vidyut moves on to the front foot and defends
poor ball to start with, he strays on to the pads from over the wicket and the length is way too full, Vidyut leans forward and flicks the ball to the deep square leg boundary
superb first over, Fleming tries to drive the last ball through the off side but gets an inside edge towards the leg side, Pollock does the fielding
this time Pollock gives Fleming a bit of width outside off stump and Fleming attempts to play the square drive off the back foot, he gets beaten and the Wankhede roars
once again Fleming moves on to the front foot and opens the face to steer a good length delivery that angles across him towards point
good length delivery on off stump, Fleming moves forward and opens the face to play the ball towards point
a bit too straight this time, on middle stump, Vidyut moves forward and flicks the ball off his pads towards long leg
perfect Pollock, he pitches on a good length just outside off stump and seams the ball across the left-hander, Vidyut lets the ball go
that's the match! Jayasuriya lofts Kapugedera straight down the ground for four, Vidyut can't stop that either, 26 runs off Kapugedera's five balls

dropped! Jayasuriya tries to clear the leg-side boundary but gets a top edge that flies high in the air towards long off, Vidyut tries to get under it but can't get into a good position, he gets a hand on it but the ball rolls over the boundary
that's no 11! The length is fractionally short, Jayasuriya moves back and plays the short-arm pull high over deep midwicket, that's on the roof

he gets his hundred with a six! Awesome batting this, Jayasuriya swivels and pulls another short ball over the deep square leg boundary, that's his 10th six and he's got 100 off 45 balls, he's delighted and he raises his arms in triumph, the crowd love it
that's too short and Jayasuriya swivels and pulls high in the air towards deep square leg, Gony is on the boundary and he gets a bit of hand on it but couldn't prevent it from going for six
Jayasuriya attempts the reverse sweep again and mis-hits it through point
tossed up outside leg stump from over the wicket, Jayasuriya waits for it and sweeps the ball wide of the fielder at short fine leg, four more and Jayasuriya is on course for a 100
flicked off the pads towards deep midwicket
Jayasuriya tries to play a short-arm paddle sweep but gets a top edge that falls safely towards the vacant square leg region
the faster offbreak on off stump, Uthappa cuts late for  asingle
shot! Uthappa leaps down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives powerfully, it was the doosra and he's hit it wide of the fielder at long off
fuller length outside off stump, Uthappa strides forward and drives the ball through cover to retain the strike
Jayasuriya moves back and cuts a short of a length ball towards third man
Uthappa takes a step across his stumps and flicks the ball off his hips towards Murali at long leg
Joginder pitches the ball short and seams it away from the right-hander, Uthappa moves back and tries to guide the ball to third man and gets beaten
a full ball outside leg stump, Jayasuriya leans across and whips the ball fast towards fine leg where Balaji runs across and fields as the ball was about to bounce over the boundary
Uthappa moves back to a short of a length ball on middle and nudges towards midwicket for  a single
bowled flat on leg and middle stump, Jayasuriya moves back and across and nudges behind square
Jayasuriya tries to play a reverse sweep but gets beaten!
bowled flat and fast on middle and off, Jayasuriya moves back and cuts the ball late and beats the man at short third man, deft
Jayasuriya tries to slog sweep across the line, Murali fires the ball flat and fast and spins the ball across the left-hander
driven to long-on for a single
Uthappa goes down on one knee to pull but misses, he gets hit on the pad, loud appeal for leg before but it was too high
slips down leg side first up, that turned too and the umpire calls it wide
defended on the back foot towards the off side

that's his eighth six! The length is short and Jayasuriya swivels and plays a short arm jab that sends the ball flying flat and fast over the deep square leg boudnary, that bounced on the rope in fact

full ball angling into the left-hander, Jayasuriya strides forward and lofts the ball powerfully into the gap between deep cover and long off, placed with precision, this is Mumbai's highest individual score of the tournament
that is short and wide down leg side, Uthappa can't connect with the pull and Dhoni can't collect cleanly either, that's hard to take when you're standing up to the stumps
this time Uthappa gets beaten outside off stump
in the air but safe! Uthappa moves forward and tries to drive a good length ball straight, he mis-hits it in the air but the ball falls safely through extra cover and runs to the boundary
Jayasuriya moves across his stumps and tries to flick but misses and gets hit on the pad, that pitched well outside leg
Balaji goes wide of the crease and angles the ball into the right-hander, Uthappa defends on the front foot towards the leg side
fuller length on off stump, Uthappa leans forward and drives firmly back towards the bowler
a good length ball seams away from the right-hander, Uthappa pokes and gets beaten
that's very wide outside off stump, Uthappa moves across and reaches out for it but still can't make contact
good length delivery outside off, Uthappa moves back and across and defends towards point
good length ball angling into the left-hander from roudn the wicket, cut off the back foot behind point
short and wide outside off stump, Jayasuriya jumps on to the back foot and cuts the ball in the air but fine towards the third-man boundary, lovely control
good length on off stump, Uthappa gets behind the line on the back foot and blocks
Uthappa leans forward and across to a good length ball on off stump and defends towards point
a bit too straight this time, on middle and leg, Uthappa flicks off his pads through square leg
pitches outside off stump and seams a long way away from Uthappa who lets it go

he's bowled him! The Wankhede has been silenced! Tendulkar strides forward to drive, the ball pitches on a good length on off stump and nips back into the right hander, it goes through the gap between bat and pad and hits middle stump
Joginder pitches wide outside off stump and seams it further away, Tendulkar tries to reach for it but can't
excellent start, on a good length just outside off stump, Tendulkar strides forward and lets the ball go
Tendulkar moves on to the back foot and opens the face of the bat to steer the ball towards third man, he retains the strike
good length once again on off stump, Tendulkar defends on the back foot, pretty good over so far, just the two wides off it
a slower full toss outside off stump, Tendulkar nudges it towards midwicket off the front foot
tight line and length on off and middle, Tendulkar nudges towards the on side and wants the single, Balaji runs across and cuts it off
good length ball on off and middle, defended on the leg side off the front foot
another wide, this time the length is full and the line is down leg side
that is too wide outside off stump, the ball seams further away from the right-hander
full ball outside off stump, it seams away from Tendulkar who watches it closely and lets it go
Jayasuriya tries to blast the ball through the off side but mis-times the drive to mid-off

that's on the roof! Jayasuriya is hitting it like he hit it in 1996! The length is full on the pads, he leans across and flicks the ball powerfully over deep backward square leg, the ball bounces off the roof
good length ball outside off, Jayasuriya moves back and punches towards mid-off, a dot ball, fancy that!
Morkel pitches the ball wide outside leg stump, the length is short and Jayasuriya can't connect with the swivel pull
it's not that short and wide this time but Jayasuriya moves back and cuts the ball fiercely through the gap at point, he's blazed to 50 off 25 balls, it's been manic, it's been special
wide outside off stump and short as well, Jayasuriya frees his arms and lashes the ball over point, it bounces once before racing over the boundary
simply awesome! The length is full on leg stump and Jayasuriya picks up the length early and plays his favourite pick-up shot and lofts the ball far over deep backward square leg
slower ball and Jayasuriya works the ball off his pads behind square
and again! Jayasuriya moves back to a short of a length delivery outside off stump and cuts it with a lot of bottom hand over the backward point boundary, Gony looks helpless
banged in short but down leg side, the wide brings up Mumbai's 50

short, wide and six! Jayasuriya gets under a wide ball outside off stump and cuts the ball high and far over the point boudnary, Gony's suffering the same fate that several bowlers have suffered at the hands of Jayasuriya
good length delivery outside off, Jayasuriya moves back and cuts the ball to point, it was in the air and fell just short of the fielder
he's launched that! Jayasuriya moves forward to a full ball and drives it flat and far over cover, he's hit that with a lot of bottom hand and the ball just clears the boundary
Jayasuriya moves back and tries to cut a ball which is wide enough for the shot, Gony beats him with the bounce
good length ball which bounces nicely through to Dhoni after Tendulkar lets it go
Jayasuriya tries to work the ball through the leg side but gets hit on the thigh for  a leg bye

this time the ball boy pulls out of the catch! Jayasuriya moves forward to a full ball and lofts cleanly over long-on, the ball just clears the boundary and the ball boy who began to attempt the catch pulled out
good length delivery close to off stump, Jayasuriya moves back and cuts to point
flicked off the pads behind square

superb effort from the ball boy outside the third man boundary but he drops it! Tendulkar reaches out for a wide ball outside off stump, it would have been called wide, he slashes and the ball soars towards third man, the ball boy dives towards his right but can't hold on
good length delivery on off stump, defended off the back foot towards point, only four off the over from Gony, good stuff
Jayasuriya moves across his stumps to flick but Gony strays down leg side once again, he's having trouble finishing what is an excellent over
Gony strays down leg side, Jayasuriya tries to play the leg glance but misses
Tendulkar leans forward and punches a good length ball towards cover where Badrinath fumbles and allows the single
Tendulakr leans across his stumps to flick a ball on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pad, Dhoni appeals for leg before but the ball is missing leg
tight line and length on middle stump, Jayasuriya moves back and nudges the ball towards the leg side, Tendulkar calls him through for the single
a good length ball on off stump stops on Jayasuriya a touch as he comes forward to defend on the leg side
quick one this time, short and takes Jayasuriya by complete surprise, takes off and speeds past the batsman's ears, perfume ball that

short of a length and straight again, good comeback from Morkel, batsma  tries to turn to the leg side and is struck on the pads, appeal goes up but that was too high for starters, probably pitched outside leg too
back of a length, cramped for room this time, defended carefully back to the bowler
he's lifted that nonchalantly, short-arm jab again and this time soars over midwicket for six, that was too close to leg stump and the flick is too easy
defended to point
133.8kph, short of a length and coming back in, batsman leaves it and that was close to the stumps
short, wide and blasted, short-arm jab through cover for four, timed sweetly and that's racing away
too wide outside off, Jayasuriya can't get the slash, wide called by Billy Doctrove, now that's strange, not given for Gony in the last over but given here
thick edge there but that's soaring through to third man for a four, that was quick and outside off, moving away too, Tendulkar pushes hard and a thick edge flies away
swinging again, but that's too far outside off, pitching well outside and moving away, Tendulkar slashes but can't reach the ball, looks at the umpire for a wide but can't get the sign
132.8kph, bounce outside off and carry too, nice bit of shape but Tendulkar didn't have to play at it, drops his hands and lets go
chipped over the on side but fantastic fielding from Murali, some great footwork and keeps them down to three, that wasn't too well timed but was running away over the fast outfield
full and outside off this time, pacy too, pushed to mid-off
good-length ball on off and moving away, pushed back to the bowler
